description: This Java interface defines a builder API for creating Akka HTTP WebSocket routes with customizable components such as event sniffers, authorization enforcers, supervisors, signal enrichment providers, and header translators. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically within the gateway endpoints for WebSocket routes.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteBuilder
classes.description: A builder interface for creating WebSocket routes with configurable parameters such as event sniffers, authorization, supervision, signal enrichment, and header translation, culminating in the creation of an Akka HTTP Route.

methods.name: withIncomingEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer used for processing incoming WebSocket messages, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: withOutgoingEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer used for processing outgoing WebSocket messages, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Configures the authorization enforcer for WebSocket connections, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: withWebSocketSupervisor
methods.description: Sets a supervisor for the WebSocket connection, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Configures the signal enrichment provider; can be null, in which case streaming requests with 'extraFields' fail, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: withHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Sets the header translator for WebSocket messages, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Akka HTTP Route for the WebSocket connection based on the specified version, correlation ID, headers, and chosen protocol adapter.
